reason: An update-monitoring plugin that periodically or manually checks the npm registry for DSH versions, presents results in Settings, and emits notifications without executing updates.

summaries.zh: 在设置页面显示 DSH 当前与最新版本，支持手动或定时检查并发送检查事件，但不会执行更新。
summaries.en: Displays current and latest DSH versions in Settings, supports manual or scheduled checks, and emits check events without executing updates.

capabilities: Queries the npm registry for the latest DSH version
Runs scheduled and manual update checks
Exposes same-origin status and check routes
Displays update status in a settings interface and emits check events
